title: Dornsife Undergraduate Advising (Cluster Advising)
text:
ADVISOR ASSIGNMENT AND STRUCTURE
- Starting Spring Term 2026, Dornsife Advising uses a Cluster Advising model, reflected in Advise USC (https://www.usc.edu/advise).
- Advisors work in case teams. Students can "meet with any advisor within your Cluster Focus area."
- Each advisor on a case team has access to the student's academic goals, progress and questions.
- Students are assigned an academic advisor based on their major and minor.
- The three academic clusters are humanities, natural sciences and social sciences.

BOOKING AN ADVISOR
- The page does not describe a booking process or scheduling tool. The only booking-related link is Advise USC (https://www.usc.edu/advise).
